title: Payment retries hammer the card network on 429
body: When the card network returns 429 we retry immediately. Use exponential backoff with jitter, cap at 5 attempts, and never retry 400 validation errors. See payments/retry.go.

title: Verify Stripe webhook signatures before mutating ledger
body: Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body with the endpoint secret. Reject if timestamp skew is greater than five minutes. Log mismatches without echoing the secret.

title: FHIR patient search leaked cross-tenant IDs
body: Always scope patient search by organizationId before name match. Partial name queries must use case-insensitive collation. Never return cross-tenant IDs from search handlers.

title: Invoice adjustment race on concurrent payouts
body: Two adjust workers can double-apply a credit. Serialize adjustments per member_id with a conditional update on billing/adjust.go version field.

title: Checkout staleTime causes double charge UI flicker
body: Set React Query staleTime to 30s for checkout aggregates and invalidate only after confirmed capture. Avoid refetchOnWindowFocus on the kiosk checkout page.

title: Claims dashboard treemap paints root as hotspot
body: Root node intensity must stay 0 so the container stays neutral. Sibling max drives leaf tiers. Palette should stay grey, mint, amber, light red, hard red.

title: CLI transfer command ignores idempotency key
body: Pass X-Idempotency-Key on every transfer POST. Reuse the same key for retries within ten minutes so ledger entries stay unique.

title: Eligibility cache serves stale plan after mid-cycle change
body: Invalidate eligibility cache keys on plan_version bump. TTL alone is not enough when benefits change mid-cycle in legacy/eligibility.go.
